scope: Exposed public VideoXum temporal mechanism diagnostic; not official joint score
baseline_reference: All three controls independently reproduce R26 per-source F within 1e-12
empty_gt_convention: Public R26 evaluator uses 0 for both-empty; no official boundary claim
limitations: 14 DEV sources already exposed in R24/R26; no independent confirmation claim
VideoXum shortened-summary annotation policy differs from generic excitingness and AIC
No crop GT and no official score inference
The plugin uses an expected-numerator/expected-denominator approximation, not an exact posterior Bayes decision
Position conditioning is limited to this fixed cubic specification; no universal content-causality claim
GT-assisted diagnostics are nondeployable and use full GT unavailable to the actual input
GT block-mean broadcast is one feasible diagnostic recipe, not an upper bound on input learnability
Annotation-positive runs are not assumed to be physical events
The practical gate is a resource allocation criterion; its numerical choice is not a statistical law
